mount_behavior: In Kaggle notebooks the SDK attaches notebook output under the Kaggle cache mount, normally /kaggle/input; this prefix uses the returned file path directly and does not assume the mount slug.

kaggle_execution_observation.reported_error: BackendError: New Notebooks cannot be attached in non-interactive sessions. Version [1] requested, found no versions attached...
kaggle_execution_observation.interpretation: The source notebook output must first be attached through an interactive editor run; this is a session capability restriction, not an access denial.
kaggle_execution_observation.next_action: Save & Run All with the successfully attached input; version 2 was started.
